svg.title: 성경 세계 지리 바탕 지도
svg.desc: Natural Earth public-domain 50m land and 10m natural lakes and rivers. Geographic reference, not a reconstruction of ancient coasts or borders. Equirectangular extent 8E–51E, 23N–45N. No political boundaries. Terrain shading: Natural Earth SR_50M (SRTM Plus-derived), public domain. Coastal extrusion is decorative, not measured bathymetry.
